title: CIA Triad with Example Threats and Controls
description: An interactive SVG infographic of the CIA triad — Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability — pairing each property with a concrete example threat (red) and supporting control (green), with hover definitions on each vertex.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Describe the three properties of the CIA triad and what each protects.
Match an example threat and an example control to the property each affects.

instructionalStrategies: Hover each vertex to read the property definition, then study its threat/control pair.
Ask students to add a second threat and control for each property from their own experience.

assessmentQuestions.question: Which CIA property does a DDoS attack violate, and which controls defend it?
Can a single incident violate more than one property at once? Give an example.
